community_list_entries.name: UTILMEM: Benchmarking Evidence Utilization in Long-Term Conversational Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Diagnostic benchmark of 1,717 instances across 5 domains (learning support, finance, mental wellness, fitness, 10-K document analysis). Each instance is a multi-session user-assistant history of about 60–70 sessions (~120K tokens) with adversarial distractors. Tests implicit relevance, dense-history
